pr.title: docs/ gains a CLI manual, and the commands stop living only in --help
pr.head: 6a310a40969a2b01870c98c28aef5e72221d5f5a

summary: Field is a command-line tool for music production. A Field project is a Git repository of YAML files, and the field command builds its audio through a dependency graph with a content-addressed cache. The docs/ directory explains the concepts (tracks, the project model, the build graph, the audio engine), but no page said what to type. This pull request adds docs/cli.md, a manual organized by task: install, labels, check, look around, build, play, the transport, export, create, generate, plugins, and sc render, then environment variables, platform notes, and a command table.
The manual's examples are transcripts taken from examples/bloom, the two-song example project in this repository. Two one-line edits list the new page in docs/README.md and in AGENTS.md.

The branch was written in August against an older main. On 2026-10-10, main was merged into it and the manual's two plan links were repointed at the docs/projects/<name>/readme.md layout. That merge also brought in recording and the remote commands, which change what several documented commands do and print. The manual has not caught up with them, and four finding threads are open at this head.

cards.title: Review history so far
cards.html:
• 2026-08-18. The author's own two passes. The play fallback paragraph was rewritten to describe today's behavior and to name the Windows port, #161, as in flight.
  • 2026-09-07, on dcabd76. A Projector review filed two findings: two plan links that the Projector layout move broke, and two transcripts on creek/track:space that fail on a fresh checkout.
  • 2026-10-10, on 6a310a4. The link finding is fixed and resolved. The creek/track:space finding still holds. Three new findings: four transcripts that differ from what the code prints, play refusals that no longer exist, and a command reference without recording or the remote commands.

cards.title: Terms this page uses
cards.html:
• Label. The address of something buildable, such as //songs/creek/track:main. The CLI also accepts creek/track:main, and a bare song name such as creek means that song's output track.
  • Live song and built artifact. field play creek plays the song live, evaluated in the engine. field play creek/track:main plays the rendered WAV file from disk.
  • field-audiod. The audio daemon. It plays sound, and every build spawns it to render.
  • Gen node and take. A generated sound, such as creek/gen:still-water-keys, and one of its generated variants. Bloom commits the request but not the takes, so a fresh checkout has none.
  • Bloom. examples/bloom, the example project with the songs creek and tall-grass.

groups.title: The CLI manual
groups.kicker: One new page that walks through each task the field command does, with transcripts from examples/bloom
intro: docs/cli.md is for someone with a checkout who wants to use field. Each section names a task, gives the command, and shows what it prints. A label is the address of something buildable, such as //songs/creek/track:main. The CLI also accepts the shorter creek/track:main, and a bare song name means that song's output track.

The distinction the manual leans on most is in the Play section. Naming a bare song plays it live, evaluated in the engine. Naming an explicit label plays the built artifact, a rendered WAV file, from disk. field-audiod is the daemon that both plays and renders audio.

Read the page against the code at this head rather than against itself. The merge of main changed the play options, field devices, field --version, the build output, and field choose, and it added field record and the remote commands. The flags below mark where the page and the code disagree.

checks.text: The review read this head without running it, because its author has no write access to the repository. Each claim below was traced in src/cli.ts and the command modules it calls.

files.note: The new manual. Read the Play section (lines 192 to 248) and the command reference (lines 425 to 452) most closely.

checks.text: Every stem, resample, and hosted-plugin insert renders by spawning field-audiod (src/generators/stem.ts, src/generators/resample.ts), not only these five effects. The instruction to build the daemon first is stronger than this sentence says.

Four transcripts show output these commands do not print at this head. field --version now prints a remote line after worker protocol 2. field devices prints an output: heading and an input: list. field export creek --rate 44100 --bit-depth 16 writes creek-track-main.44100-16-v<n>.wav. field import reports audio/rain/rain.wav. The fix is to rerun the four commands against bloom and paste what they print.
These counts match bloom at this head: creek has 14 track files with 25 inputs, and tall-grass has 6 and 6. Counted by parsing the track YAML under examples/bloom/songs/.

This transcript and the field query one on line 139 fail on a fresh checkout. space takes cable inputs from track:keys and track:lead-vocal, whose generated takes bloom does not commit, so both commands exit 1 with "has no takes yet". The fix is a sentence saying to generate creek's takes first, or a label that resolves without them.
The status column matches buildStatus in src/cli.ts: the word padded to six characters, two spaces, then the label and its .field/out path. Traced through the build action that prints it.

Neither refusal exists at this head. A live song takes the engine click, and --from with --loop on a live song is a region loop (playLiveSession in src/commands/play.ts). docs/audio-engine.md on this branch says so. The "(artifacts only)" on line 220 and the pull request body's first bullet make the same outdated claim.
One of the four transcripts that the flag on line 50 covers. At this head the command prints an output: heading before these lines, then an input: list with channel counts.

One of the four transcripts that the flag on line 50 covers. exportBaseName keeps the track segment, and a converted export starts its own version family, so this command writes ~/Desktop/creek-track-main.44100-16-v<n>.wav.
One of the four transcripts that the flag on line 50 covers. field import reports the song-relative path, audio/rain/rain.wav.

#161 is still open, so "in review" is true today. On this branch, §2.2 of the Windows plan is still an open decision with a recommendation. The amendment this sentence cites arrives with #161, and an earlier review accepted that gap.

Both plan links resolve at this head. Listing the tree shows docs/projects/windows-portability/readme.md and docs/projects/linux-portability/readme.md, and the link text keeps the windows-portability.md form that docs/projects/README.md asks for.

The command reference leaves out field record, field choose --take, and login, logout, clone, push, and pull, all of which the merge of main added. Four statements are narrower than the code as a result: field devices also lists inputs, field build also prints fetched, field choose also takes --take, and the environment table lacks FIELD_REMOTE and FIELD_TOKEN.
